cues.zh: 如果你对宇宙中每一个粒子都了如指掌，
cues.en: If you have perfect knowledge of every single particle in the universe,

cues.zh: 你能用物理定律一路回溯到大爆炸吗？
cues.en: can you use the laws of physics to rewind all the way back to the Big Bang?

cues.zh: 宇宙的整个历史是完全可知的吗？还是说信息在某个环节上丢失了？
cues.en: Is the entire history of the universe perfectly knowable? Or has information somehow been lost along the way?

cues.zh: 物理定律就是运动方程。
cues.en: The laws of physics are equations of motion.

cues.zh: 它们是支配系统随时间演化的数学规则。
cues.en: They are mathematical rules that dictate how systems evolve in time.

cues.zh: 经典力学的牛顿方程，
cues.en: Newton's equations for classical mechanics,

cues.zh: 电磁学的麦克斯韦方程，
cues.en: Maxwell's equations for electromagnetism.

cues.zh: 以及量子力学的薛定谔方程。
cues.en: and the Schrödinger equation for quantum mechanics.

cues.zh: 这些定律可以用来预测宇宙未来会如何演化。
cues.en: These laws can be used to predict how the universe will evolve into the future.

cues.zh: 它们是确定性的。
cues.en: They are deterministic.

cues.zh: 对系统当前状态的完美认知，能完美预测
cues.en: Perfect knowledge of a system in the present perfectly predicts

cues.zh: 系统在下一瞬间、再下一瞬间会如何变化，如此无限延续。
cues.en: how the system will change in the next instant and the instant after that, ad infinitum.

cues.zh: 但时间正方向上的确定性，并不能保证同样的定律可以完美预测过去。
cues.en: But determinism in the forward time direction does not guarantee that the same laws can perfectly predict the past.

cues.zh: 然而，这种确定性的对称性，也就是时间反演对称性，对信息本身守恒至关重要。
cues.en: And yet this sort of deterministic symmetry, time-reversal symmetry, is essential for information itself to be conserved.

cues.zh: 今天我们来了解，为什么信息守恒是量子力学如此根本的要求。
cues.en: Today, we learn why conservation of information is such a fundamental requirement of quantum mechanics.

cues.zh: 在未来的某一集里，我们会看到黑洞如何可能打破这条定律。
cues.en: In a future episode, we'll see how this law might be broken by black holes.

cues.zh: 用物理定律做预测的一个重要工具
cues.en: An important tool for making predictions with the laws of physics

cues.zh: 是我们从中推导出的守恒定律。
cues.en: are the conservation laws that we derive from them.

cues.zh: 正如我们最近讨论过的，我们可以用诺特定理来发现系统中守恒的量
cues.en: As we discussed recently, we can use Noether's theorem to discover quantities that are conserved in a system

cues.zh: 方法是考察运动方程的对称性。
cues.en: by looking at the symmetries of the equations of motion.

cues.zh: 例如，如果方程从一个时刻到下一个时刻保持不变，那么能量就守恒。
cues.en: For example, if the equations stay the same from one point in time to the next, then energy is conserved.

cues.zh: 诺特定理适用于光滑连续的对称性
cues.en: Noether's theorem applies to smooth continuous symmetries

cues.zh: 我们可以任意变换所选坐标
cues.en: where we can transform the chosen coordinate

cues.zh: 而不改变系统本身。
cues.en: however much we like without changing the system.

cues.zh: 但也存在离散变换下的对称性。
cues.en: But there are also symmetries under discrete transformations.

cues.zh: 它们更像开关。
cues.en: They're more like on-off switches.

cues.zh: 例如，我们可以反转所有电荷
cues.en: For example, we could reverse all electric charges

cues.zh: 或者通过照镜子翻转 x 轴
cues.en: or we could flip the x-axis by looking in a mirror

cues.zh: 或者让时间倒流。
cues.en: or we could make time run backwards.

cues.zh: 最后一种对称性，即时间反演对称性
cues.en: Symmetry in that last one, time-reversal symmetry

cues.zh: 不在诺特定理的覆盖范围内，但它仍与一条守恒定律相关：
cues.en: isn't covered by Noether's theorem, but it's still tied to a conservation law:

cues.zh: 信息守恒。
cues.en: the conservation of information.

cues.zh: 我们说一个系统具有时间反演对称性，如果它的运动方程
cues.en: We say that a system is time-reversal symmetric if its equations of motion

cues.zh: 允许我们仅通过知道系统在任意较晚时刻的状态，就能完美预测其起点。
cues.en: allow us to perfectly predict the starting point simply by knowing the state of the system at any later time.

cues.zh: 如果允许我们倒转时钟，推算出唯一的历史。
cues.en: If they allow us to rewind the clock and figure out a single unique history.

cues.zh: 整个宇宙将具有时间反演对称性，
cues.en: The entire universe would be time-reversal symmetric

cues.zh: 只要知道某一时刻宇宙中每个粒子的确切状态，
cues.en: if knowing the exact state of every particle in the universe at one point in time

cues.zh: 就能计算出它在所有时刻的确切历史。
cues.en: allowed us to calculate its exact past history at all times.

cues.zh: 这意味着宇宙在任意时刻的确切构型，
cues.en: That would mean that the exact configuration of the universe at any point in time

cues.zh: 都决定了它在任何其他时刻的确切构型。
cues.en: defines the exact configuration at any other point.

cues.zh: 首先，
cues.en: For one thing,

cues.zh: 这种时间反演对称性意味着，关于过去所有时刻构型的完整信息
cues.en: this time-reversal symmetry means complete information about the configuration at all prior times

cues.zh: 仍然存在，而且永远存在，即使我们实际上无法获取它。
cues.en: still exists, and always will, even if we can't practically access it.

cues.zh: 这就是我所说的信息守恒。
cues.en: That's what I mean about conservation of information.

cues.zh: 一个相关的概念是因果决定论。
cues.en: A related idea is causal determinism.

cues.zh: 即完美地了解当前状态，就能完美地预测所有未来状态。
cues.en: The idea that perfectly knowing the current state perfectly predicts all future states.

cues.zh: 但这种未来的确定性不一定具有时间反演对称性。
cues.en: But this sort of future determinism doesn't have to be time-reversal symmetric.

cues.zh: 未来的状态完全有可能根据物理定律被完美预测，而过去却不能。
cues.en: It's possible for the future to be perfectly predictable by the laws of physics while the past is not.

cues.zh: 例如，如果现在有许多不同的粒子配置
cues.en: For example, what if many different configurations of particles in the present

cues.zh: 都可能在将来汇聚成单一的粒子配置呢？
cues.en: could converge on a single configuration of particles in the future?

cues.zh: 如果多种状态都能演化成同一个状态，
cues.en: If a multitude of states can all evolve into the same state,

cues.zh: 那么仅知道后来的状态，并不足以让我们推断出是哪些过去的状态导致了它。
cues.en: then knowing the later state isn't enough for us to figure out what past states led to it.

cues.zh: 例如，假设你有两个状态，A 和 B，
cues.en: For example, imagine you have two states, A and B,

cues.zh: 而运动定律表明 A 变成 C，B 变成 D。
cues.en: and the laws of motion say that A becomes C and B becomes D.

cues.zh: 如果我们观察后来的状态，看到状态 C，就知道 A 先出现，
cues.en: If we look at the later state and see state C, we know A came first,

cues.zh: 但如果看到状态 D，就知道 B 先出现。
cues.en: but if we see state D, we know B came first

cues.zh: 但如果 A 和 B 都导向状态 C 呢？
cues.en: But what if both A and B lead to state C?

cues.zh: 那个未来方向是确定性的，
cues.en: That future direction is deterministic,

cues.zh: 但现在，如果我们看最终状态，会看到状态 C
cues.en: but now, if we look at the final state, we see state C

cues.zh: 但我们不知道是 A 还是 B 导致了它。
cues.en: But we don't know which of A or B led to it.

cues.zh: 关于那些过去状态的信息就会丢失。
cues.en: The information about those past states would be lost.

cues.zh: 好。
cues.en: Okay.

cues.zh: 所以抹除信息应该足够简单，对吧？
cues.en: So it should be simple enough to erase information, right?

cues.zh: 我们只要这样设定，让运动定律迫使两个可能的初始状态进入完全相同的最终状态。
cues.en: We just set things up so our laws of motion force two possible initial states into the same exact final state.

cues.zh: 那样我们就不知道原始状态是什么，信息就被摧毁了。
cues.en: Then we wouldn't know what the original state was and information would be destroyed.

cues.zh: 实际上，量子力学禁止这样做。
cues.en: Actually, quantum mechanics forbids this.

cues.zh: 它确保了信息守恒和时间反演对称性，因为有一条更基本的规则：
cues.en: It ensures conservation of information and time-reversal symmetry because of an even more fundamental rule:

cues.zh: 概率守恒。
cues.en: The conservation of probability.

cues.zh: 为了理解这一点，
cues.en: To get at this,

cues.zh: 让我们想想量子力学的基本运动方程。
cues.en: let's think about the basic equation of motion of quantum mechanics.

cues.zh: 这就是薛定谔方程。
cues.en: That's the Schrödinger equation.

cues.zh: 含时薛定谔方程描述了所谓波函数随时间的演化。
cues.en: The time dependent Schrödinger equation describes the time evolution of this thing called The Wave Function.

cues.zh: 一个系统的波函数完整描述了它的所有性质，
cues.en: The wavefunction of a system fully describes all of its properties

cues.zh: 在量子力学中，这意味着所有这些性质的概率分布，
cues.en: and in quantum mechanics that means the probability distribution of all those properties,

cues.zh: 你可以通过波函数的平方来得到它。
cues.en: which you can get by taking the square of the wave function.

cues.zh: 例如，一个粒子的波函数包含了在测量其位置时，
cues.en: For example, the wave function of a particle encapsulates the probability that it'll be found in

cues.zh: 它会在某个位置被找到的概率。
cues.en: this or that location if we were to try to measure its position.

cues.zh: 薛定谔方程能完美预测给定波函数
cues.en: The Schrodinger equation perfectly predicts both the past and future evolution of a given wave function

cues.zh: 在任意给定环境中的过去和未来演化，用量子术语说，就是在任意给定势场中的演化。
cues.en: in any given environment, or in quantum speak, in any given potential.

cues.zh: 从这个意义上说，它是确定性的、时间反演对称的，因此守恒信息。
cues.en: In that sense, it's deterministic and time-reversal symmetric and so conserves information.

cues.zh: 原则上，“给定势场中的给定波函数”
cues.en: In principle, "a given wave function in a given potential"

cues.zh: 可以指电子在原子电场中运动的波函数
cues.en: could mean the wave function of an electron moving in an atom's electric field

cues.zh: 也可以指整个宇宙在其自身极其复杂且不断变化的势场中的波函数。
cues.en: or it could mean the wave function of the entire universe in its own impossibly complex and changing potential.

cues.zh: 因此，薛定谔方程保证了时间可逆性，从而保证了信息守恒，
cues.en: So the Schrödinger equation guarantees time reversibility and so the conservation of information,

cues.zh: 量子力学的更高级表述也是如此，比如狄拉克方程和量子场论。
cues.en: as do the more advanced formulations of quantum mechanics, like the Dirac equation and quantum field theories.

cues.zh: 这一保证源于这些理论一个非常根本的基础性质。
cues.en: That guarantee arises from a really fundamental foundational quality of these theories.

cues.zh: 它来自我们所说的幺正性。
cues.en: It comes from what we call Unitarity.

cues.zh: 记住，波函数概括了给定属性的概率分布。
cues.en: Remember that the wave function encapsulates the distribution of probabilities for a given property.

cues.zh: 根据定义，这些概率之和应该等于1。
cues.en: By definition, those probabilities should add up to 1.

cues.zh: 这只是说，任何给定属性都有某个可能取值的概率是100%,
cues.en: That just means there's a 100% probability that any given property will have some possible value,

cues.zh: 即使那个取值为零。
cues.en: even if that value is zero.

cues.zh: 就粒子位置而言，概率加起来等于1，只是意味着粒子肯定在某个地方。
cues.en: In the case of particle position, probability of adding to one just means that the particle is definitely somewhere.

cues.zh: 而且，随着时间推移，粒子的属性会继续具有可能取值。
cues.en: And, as time goes on, a particle's properties will continue to have possible values.

cues.zh: 概率应当始终求和为1。
cues.en: The probability should continue to sum to 1.

cues.zh: 如果这一点成立，而且它必须成立，
cues.en: If this is true, and it must be,

cues.zh: 我们就说波函数的时间演化是幺正的。
cues.en: we say that the time evolution of the wave function is unitary.

cues.zh: 而这种幺正性，是量子力学与量子场论所有表述中的一个基础假设。
cues.en: And this unitarity is a foundational assumption in all formulations of quantum mechanics and quantum field theories.

cues.zh: 幺正性是关于概率如何运作的一个不可妥协的陈述，
cues.en: Unitarity is a non-negotiable statement about how probability works,

cues.zh: 但这个条件也保证了时间反演对称性和信息守恒。
cues.en: but the condition also ensures time-reversal symmetry and conservation of information.

cues.zh: 不涉及一些复杂的数学，很难直白解释
cues.en: It's not straightforward to explain without getting into some hairy math

cues.zh: 但结论是，量子态必须彼此保持独立，才能维持概率守恒。
cues.en: but the upshot is that quantum states must remain independent of each other in order to preserve probability.

cues.zh: 两个独立的量子态不可能演化成完全相同的量子态。
cues.en: Two independent quantum states can't evolve into the exact same quantum state.

cues.zh: 如果真能如此，那么初始状态或最终状态的概率就无法同时都加和为1。
cues.en: If they did, then the probabilities for the initial states or for the final state can't both sum to 1.

cues.zh: 回到第一个例子，量子态A和B
cues.en: Back to our first example, quantum states A and B

cues.zh: 不可能同时变成量子态C，
cues.en: can't both become quantum states C,

cues.zh: 合并前的概率之和就不会等于合并后的概率之和
cues.en: the sum of the probabilities prior to the merger would not equal the sum of the probabilities after the merger

cues.zh: 幺正性就会被破坏。
cues.en: and unitarity would be broken.

cues.zh: 唯一既能保持概率守恒又能保持幺正性的演化方式，是同时保持量子态数量的演化，
cues.en: The only type of evolution that preserves probability and unitarity is the evolution that also preserves the number of quantum states,

cues.zh: 而量子态的保持就意味着信息的保持
cues.en: and the preservation of quantum states means preservation of information

cues.zh: 因为你可以沿着时间无限地向前和向后追踪一个量子态。
cues.en: because you can trace a quantum state indefinitely forwards and backwards in time.

cues.zh: 但所有这些关于量子力学具有确定性的说法，似乎与量子随机性和不确定性原理的观点有些矛盾。
cues.en: But all of this talk of quantum mechanics being deterministic seems a bit at odds with the idea of quantum randomness and the uncertainty principle.

cues.zh: 毕竟，测量的行为难道不是从某个量的可能值范围中挑选出一个单一的值吗？
cues.en: After all, doesn't the act of measurement pick a single value of some quantity from the range of possible values?

cues.zh: 那个值似乎是基于波函数中编码的概率分布随机选择的
cues.en: That value seems to be chosen randomly based on the probability distribution encoded in the wave function

cues.zh: 而该值可知性的精度由不确定性原理所定义。
cues.en: and the precision of the knowability of that value is defined by the uncertainty principle.

cues.zh: 看起来信息确实可能丢失。
cues.en: It sure seems like information can be lost.

cues.zh: 但那并不是我们所说的量子信息的真正含义。
cues.en: But that's not really what we mean by quantum information.

cues.zh: 量子信息指的是波函数的完整信息内容，
cues.en: Quantum information refers to the full information content of the wave function,

cues.zh: 而不仅仅是我们测量到的内容，并且原则上，
cues.en: not just what we measure, and in principle,

cues.zh: 进行足够多的测量，你就能从波函数中提取出所有的信息。
cues.en: make enough measurements and you can extract all of the information from a wave function.

cues.zh: 值得一提的是，量子力学哥本哈根诠释中的波函数坍缩
cues.en: It's worth mentioning that the collapse of the wave function in the Copenhagen interpretation of quantum mechanics

cues.zh: 确实会破坏信息守恒。
cues.en: actually does mess with conservation of information.

cues.zh: 按照这种诠释，测量行为实际上改变了整个波函数，
cues.en: According to that interpretation, the act of measurement actually alters the entire wave function,

cues.zh: 使其收缩到测量结果所暗示的狭窄可能值范围内。
cues.en: causing it to shrink down to the narrow range of possible values implied by the result of the measurement.

cues.zh: 但被测量后的波函数无法反向追踪以恢复过去的波函数。
cues.en: But that measured wave function can't then be tracked backwards to recover the past wave function.

cues.zh: 所以这种诠释既不是确定性的，也不具有时间反演对称性。
cues.en: So this interpretation is neither deterministic nor time-reversal symmetric.

cues.zh: 量子力学的其他诠释，例如，
cues.en: Other interpretations of quantum mechanics, for example,

cues.zh: 埃弗雷特的多世界诠释或德布罗意-玻姆导波理论，都保留了这种时间可逆性。
cues.en: Everett's many-worlds or the de Broglie-Bohm pilot wave theory preserve this time reversibility.

cues.zh: 在多世界诠释中，整个波函数在测量之后仍然继续存在。
cues.en: In the case of many-worlds, the entire wave function continues to exist even after measurement.

cues.zh: 那个测量本身只是可能性空间中某一部分发生的事情。
cues.en: That measurement itself is just a thing that happens in one part of the possibility space.

cues.zh: 信息其实并没有真正丢失。
cues.en: No information is really lost.

cues.zh: 而在导波理论中，
cues.en: And in the case of pilot wave theory,

cues.zh: 波函数包含了隐藏信息，这些信息随最终被测量的粒子一起携带。
cues.en: the wave function contains hidden information that is carried with the final measured particle.

cues.zh: 有一种情况，无论你偏好哪种量子力学诠释，时间可逆性似乎都被打破了。
cues.en: There is one situation where time reversibility appears to be broken regardless of your favorite interpretation of quantum mechanics.

cues.zh: 黑洞和霍金辐射就是这样的例子。
cues.en: That's the case of black holes and Hawking radiation.

cues.zh: 斯蒂芬·霍金的同名辐射似乎会摧毁量子信息，
cues.en: Stephen Hawking's eponymous radiation appears to destroy quantum information,

cues.zh: 从而引出了著名的黑洞信息悖论。
cues.en: leading to the famous black hole information paradox.

cues.zh: 在接下来的一集中，我们将探讨量子信息是否真的能从时空近乎完美的记忆中
cues.en: In an upcoming episode, we'll see whether quantum information really can be deleted

cues.zh: 被抹除。
cues.en: from the otherwise perfect memory of spacetime.

cues.zh: 我们会想念你的，但这绝对值得。
cues.en: We're gonna miss you, but it's gonna be really worth it.

cues.zh: 诺特定理从自然界的对称性预言了物理学的守恒定律。
cues.en: Noether's theorem predicts the conservation laws of physics from the symmetries of nature.

cues.zh: 你们在评论区提了一些非常棒的问题。
cues.en: You guys had some excellent questions in the comments.

cues.zh: merinsan 打算用能量损失和宇宙学红移
cues.en: merinsan has plans to use the loss of energy and cosmological redshift

cues.zh: 来反驳能量守恒的论点。
cues.en: as a refutation of conservation of energy arguments.

cues.zh: 好吧，这没问题，但得提醒一句。
cues.en: Ok, that's fine, but a word of caution.

cues.zh: 能量守恒完全成立，在人类所处理的系统尺度上始终适用。
cues.en: Conservation of energy is completely valid and always applies on the scales of systems that humans deal with.

cues.zh: 在一个相关的问题中，AFastidiousCuber 问为什么自由能和永动机是不可能的。
cues.en: In a related question, AFastidiousCuber asks why free energy and perpetual motion machines are impossible.

cues.zh: 关键在于，在这些系统的尺度上，宇宙具有时间平移对称性。
cues.en: The key is that, on the scales of these systems, the universe is time translation symmetric.

cues.zh: 在这些尺度上，空间并没有全局性地膨胀或收缩，因此能量是绝对守恒的。
cues.en: Space is not globally expanding or contracting on those scales and so energy is absolutely conserved.

cues.zh: 也许你可以提取一些自由能，如果你能造出一个横跨数百万光年的装置
cues.en: Perhaps you could extract some free energy if you could build a device that spans several million light years

cues.zh: 或者，我也不知道，装一些太阳能板。
cues.en: or, I don't know, install some solar panels.

cues.zh: 你们中有几个人问了这个很好的问题：
cues.en: A few of you asked this great question:

cues.zh: “宇宙学红移造成的能量损失，真的能变成暗能量吗？”
cues.en: "Could the energy loss to cosmological redshift actually become dark energy?"

cues.zh: 答案是不能。
cues.en: The answer is no.

cues.zh: 光子的能量密度远低于暗能量的能量密度。
cues.en: The energy density of photons is much much lower than the energy density of dark energy.

cues.zh: 暗能量现在占宇宙能量密度的70%，而且还在增大。
cues.en: Dark energy now comprises 70% of the energy density of the universe and is getting larger.

cues.zh: 辐射，包括光子和中微子
cues.en: Radiation including photons and neutrinos

cues.zh: 在大爆炸后约5万年内一直主导着能量密度
cues.en: dominated the energy density until around 50 thousand years after the Big Bang

cues.zh: 但自那以后，由于宇宙学红移，它已经下降了。
cues.en: But it's dropped off since then due to cosmological redshift.

cues.zh: 今天，它们的贡献微乎其微，不可能在推动暗能量的增长。
cues.en: Today, their contribution is minuscule, and they can't be powering the increase in dark energy.

cues.zh: Orthochronicity 深入洞察了 Emmy Noether 贡献的历史，分享了一些知识。
cues.en: Orthochronicity dropped some knowledge with a deeper insight into the history of Emmy Noether's contribution.

cues.zh: 其实，让我直接读一下这条评论：
cues.en: Actually, let me just read the comment:

cues.zh: “值得注意的是，她其实并没有真正介入去解决早期广义相对论中困扰人们的能量问题。
cues.en: "It's worth noting that she didn't really step in to tackle the energy problem that was dogging early general relativity.

cues.zh: Klein 是在一位同事的提醒下才向她请教的。
cues.en: Klein asked her for her input after being prompted by a colleague.

cues.zh: 当他这么做时，他惊讶地发现她已经解决了大部分问题，
cues.en: When he did, he was surprised to learn that she had already worked out most of the solution,

cues.zh: 但为了更重要的数学研究，她把它搁置在了一边。
cues.en: but had put it by the wayside for more important mathematics.

cues.zh: 当她真正发表时，据说 Einstein 评论说，他没想到有人能以如此普遍的方式思考引力。
cues.en: When she did publish it, Einstein supposedly remarked that he had no idea that anyone could think about gravity in such general ways.

cues.zh: 以真正的数学风格，她的工作远比我们在物理学中处理的任何东西都要普遍得多。
cues.en: In true mathematical fashion, her work was far more general than anything we deal with in physics.

cues.zh: 宇宙基本上只是一个特例。
cues.en: The universe was basically just a special case.

cues.zh: 很难低估她作为数学家有多么了不起。
cues.en: It's hard to understate just how amazing of a mathematician she was"

cues.zh: 很多人批评我们用 HTML 作为源代码的例子。
cues.en: A lot of you criticized our use of HTML as an example of source code.

cues.zh: 各位，你们真觉得宇宙用的是汇编语言、Haskell，甚至 Java 吗？
cues.en: Guys, you really think the universe uses assembly language or Haskell or, hell, even Java?

cues.zh: 这根本没那么合理。
cues.en: It doesn't make anywhere near that much sense.

cues.zh: 黑洞内存泄漏、量子舍入误差，而且编译出第一个生命体花了 100 亿年。
cues.en: Black hole memory leaks, quantum rounding errors and it took 10 billion years to compile the first lifeform.
